title: Mixtape and Playlist
author: Oscar Galloway
blurb: Casper Galloway, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
